title: Learning to Charge More: How Q-Learning Firms Lock In Supracompetitive Prices
abstract: arXiv:2505.22909v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: There is growing experimental evidence that $Q$-learning agents can learn to charge supracompetitive prices. We ask when such behavior persists, whether it emerges, and which strategies support it. In a repeated pricing game in which firms condition on the previous period's price profile, we give conditions on the learned action values under which supracompetitive prices become an absorbing state once experimentation ends. We then show that under softmax exploration these conditions are reached with positive and explicitly bounded probability, both from a random and from an all-zero initial $Q$-table. In the latter case firms lock in supracompetitive prices because they never learn that undercutting pays; the same mechanism can lock in the competitive price, so the long-run outcome is selected by the exploration path. translated_title: 学会收取更高价格：Q-Learning企业如何锁定超竞争价格
translated_abstract: 越来越多的实验证据表明，Q-Learning智能体能够学会收取超竞争价格。我们研究了这种行为何时会持续存在、是否会出现，以及哪些策略在支持它。在一个企业根据上一期价格组合进行条件定价的重复定价博弈中，我们给出了关于所学动作价值的条件，在这些条件下，一旦探索结束，超竞争价格便会成为吸收态。随后我们证明，在softmax探索下，无论是从随机的还是从全零的初始Q表出发，这些条件都会以正的且具有明确上界的概率被满足。在后一种情况下，企业之所以锁定超竞争价格，是因为它们从未学到降价是有利可图的；同样的机制也可能锁定竞争性价格，因此长期结果由探索路径所选择。最后，我们给出了关于所学Q表的充分条件，使得由此诱导出的策略构成天真合谋（naive collusion），即一种……
tldr: 该论文证明，在重复定价博弈中，Q-Learning企业在softmax探索下会以正且可明确界定界限的概率锁定超竞争价格，其核心机制是企业从未学到降价有利可图，而长期结果是竞争性价格还是合谋价格则由探索路径决定。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in a repeated pricing game, Q-learning firms lock in supracompetitive prices with positive, explicitly bounded probability under softmax exploration—because they never learn that undercutting pays—while the long-run outcome (competitive or collusive) is selected by the exploration path.
